item.description:
VisiDAW 0.2.4 — Testing release

This candidate uses production Polar licensing and the TESTING update feed.
A valid VisiDAW license is required for initial activation. Existing accepted
production activations retain the same Keychain identity across updates.

Includes Sparkle 2.10.0 update support and the shared safe-quit flow for saving
work and deferring shutdown during active recording, playback, or export.
The application and bundled FFmpeg tools contain Apple Silicon and Intel slices
and target macOS 12 or later.

Phone/WebRTC recording and MP4 export remain experimental. This candidate is
for qualification; device behavior and the live update path require manual
validation. It is not a STABLE release.
